description:
Bedtime Music | Surbahar Instrumental | 3 Hours of deep Indian sleep music for the whole night

The day ends twice — once when you decide it's over, and once when your mind agrees. This is music for the space in between.

This peaceful Indian ambient sleep music holds one deep, unbroken texture for 3 hours, so you can drift off without anything pulling you back.

You'll hear the surbahar — the deepest voice in the sitar family — moving in long, low phrases over a soft tanpura drone. No percussion, no dynamic jumps, no silences. Just depth, slowly repeating, until the room disappears.

Perfect for falling asleep, staying asleep, bedtime routines, light sleepers, late reading before bed, or keeping the night from going silent.

🎵 ABOUT THIS MUSIC
Instrument: Surbahar
Raga: Malkauns — the deep midnight raga, ancient and still
Style: Indian classical ambient, instrumental only
Mood: Deep, dark, unbroken
Duration: 3 hours

🎧 HOW TO USE
Start it at lights-out with the volume just above silence. Speaker beats headphones for sleep — let it sit under the room. The loop is seamless; nothing will wake you.

⏱ CHAPTERS
0:00:00 — Lights out
0:15:00 — The room settles
0:30:00 — First depth
0:45:00 — Drifting
1:00:00 — Deep water
1:15:00 — Middle of the night
1:30:00 — Held
1:45:00 — Still going
2:00:00 — Deepest hour
2:15:00 — Toward morning
2:30:00 — Light far off
2:45:00 — Rested

⏱ BEST FOR
Falling asleep
Staying asleep through the night
Bedtime routines
Light sleepers
Insomnia-prone nights
Late reading before bed
Masking street noise
Waking up rested
